one_line: Sultan of Mysore who fought the East India Company while expanding rocketry, administration and diplomacy in late 18th-century South India.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, medium height, sturdy and athletic build with a slight commander’s bulk rather than a lean warrior.
appearance.face: Rounded face with a broad forehead and strong jaw, medium-brown south Indian complexion, neatly trimmed thin moustache, a very faint short beard shadow along the jawline, arched brows over large expressive anime eyes, default expression calm and calculating with a hint of stern resolve.
appearance.hair: Hair kept short and neat, mostly hidden under a cream-coloured, slightly conical Mysore-style turban wrapped close to the head, with a narrow dark green band around its base and a small central gold-and-emerald crescent badge at the front.
appearance.costume: A long, knee-length, close-fitting striped angarkha-style tunic inspired by late-18th-century Mysore court dress, in soft off-white cotton with very thin vertical pale-green pinstripes and subtle gold thread edging at the neckline and cuffs; a wide dark green silk waist sash (kamarband) wrapped tightly and knotted to one side, supporting a sword; loose but neat off-white cotton churidar trousers gathered at the ankles; a simple yet elegant waist-length dark teal sleeveless overcoat (without heavy armour, just a tailored cloth layer) worn open to show the sash; on his feet, dark brown leather mojari-style shoes with slightly upturned toes; minimal jewellery: a single plain gold ring on his right hand and a narrow gold bracelet on his left wrist, plus a modest string of small dark beads just visible at the neck.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved, single-edged Indo-Persian sabre (shamshir) with a polished steel blade, a distinctive gold hilt with a shallow disc pommel and a green tassel at the end, carried in a dark brown leather scabbard with two small brass fittings, worn at his left hip through the green waist sash.

ref_desc: Tipu Sultan is a medium-built, mid-30s man with a rounded medium-brown face, thin moustache, cream Mysore turban with green band and gold crescent badge, wearing an off-white striped angarkha, dark green sash, dark teal sleeveless overcoat, churidar trousers, brown mojari shoes, and a curved gold-hilted sabre with green tassel at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Tipu Sultan as a dignified late-18th-century Mysore ruler and commander: a medium-built man in his late 30s with a rounded medium-brown face, strong jaw, thin neatly trimmed moustache, large serious eyes and calm, calculating expression; his hair is short and hidden by a cream-coloured Mysore turban wrapped tight, with a dark green band at its base and a small gold-and-emerald crescent badge centered in front. Show him in an off-white cotton angarkha-style tunic falling to the knees, closely fitted to the torso and arms, decorated with very fine vertical pale-green pinstripes and subtle gold edging at the neckline and cuffs; over this, a waist-length dark teal sleeveless overcoat hangs open, tailored and unarmoured, revealing a broad dark green silk waist sash wrapped around his midsection and tied to one side, from which hangs a dark brown leather scabbard with brass fittings. His trousers are off-white churidar, gathered at the ankles, and he wears dark brown leather mojari-style shoes with slightly upturned toes. Include minimal jewellery: a plain gold ring on his right hand, a narrow gold bracelet on his left, and a barely visible short string of dark beads at the neck. His signature weapon, a slightly curved single-edged sabre with polished steel blade, gold hilt with disc pommel and a green tassel, sits at his left hip in the scabbard, and in some poses he lightly rests his right hand on the hilt. Emphasise a consistent colour palette of off-white cloth, dark green sash and turban band, dark teal overcoat, gold accents, and dark brown leather, with clean lines and multiple angles to clearly show face, turban shape, costume details and the sword’s design.
